newsitem.title: UK: Cordiant in Moscow advertising venture.
newsitem.headline: Cordiant in Moscow advertising venture.

text.p: Cordiant Plc has set up a joint venture advertising agency in Moscow by teaming up with Russia's Video International Group of Companies, the British company said on Wednesday.

The venture combines the resources and know-how of Cordiant's international advertising networks, Bates Worldwide and Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising Worldwide, with Video International's knowledge of the local market.
The new agency, to be known as Bates VIAG Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising, will have combined billings of over $60 million.
"We plan to invest a lot in training up local Russian people," said Michael Coyle, regional director of Bates Europe.
It will have 85 staff and provide a complete advertising service to 34 clients. Around 80 percent of the staff are expected to be locals with the remainder expatriates.

The management team will be headed by Dmitry Abroschenko as chairman and Patrick Hanson-Lowe as general manager. The former now heads Video International while Hanson-Lowe is CEO of Cordiant's existing Russian advertising operations.
